description: This circular walk explores the area around the Cambridgeshire settlements of Eyeton Socon and Eynesbury. The area is located just to the south of St Neots and includes a lovely riverside park, pretty lakes, a weir, a lock, a cricket ground and riverside paths along the Ouse Valley Way .
